reviewer: Claude (simulated native reviewer, fresh context, D-10 answer-key pass)
basis: Grading read from src/lib/grading.ts, src/lib/languages/zh.ts, src/lib/writing/rubric.ts, src/lib/speech/grader.ts and src/components/exercises/match.tsx: typeAnswer/wordBank = lenient (punctuation and spaces dropped, traditional folded word by word through the lexicon, pinyin for a hanzi key = practice only, digits NOT folded); dictation = strict (no traditional fold); speech items = whole-utterance variant only (no requiredConcepts on any zh speech item); scenarios = variant OR every requiredConcepts group present as a token run; writing = rubric slots as contiguous token runs under the lexicon-bound maximal-match tokenizer (so a compound lexeme such as 见面 is one token and does not contain 见); match = the native tile text identifies the pair (first pair with that text wins).

summary.breakdown: 976 lesson exercises (staged zh-vi.json, all 108 lessons, with the 66 reception clips / 29 readings they use) + 115 checkpoint items (7 checkpoints incl. the 20-item capstone) + 22 placement items + 80 HSK 1 items (2 forms, with clips and readings) + 120 HSK 2 items (2 forms, incl. 10 书写 component and 10 pinyin-to-hanzi items) + 52 speech items (22 reserved) + 35 writing tasks (16 reserved) + 21 scenarios (42 scored learner nodes) + 126 story questions (42 stories read in full)
summary.line: 56 findings: P0 18, P1 33, P2 5 (4 marked uncertain) over 1,547 scored items read; several findings list further affected ids in alsoAffects.
notes: Section 1 is tap-only as planned (no typeAnswer, dictation or open fill-in in u0-u4, checkpoint s1 or placement stage 1). No pinyin is ever a key. Simplified throughout; typed and spoken traditional folds through the lexicon — except dictation (see the dictation finding).

The authoring self-check caught the mechanical classes well: 两/二 keys are right everywhere (两个, 二月, 十二, 二十, 两块五), 不/没 keys are right everywhere, 了/过/在 fill-ins have one answer, every measure-word fill-in has exactly one fitting classifier among its options, 吗 vs A-not-A typed keys list both where asked (你有没有哥哥, 你有没有微信).

Largest P0 class (7 items): a correct word-bank order or typed rendering the course itself teaches or accepts elsewhere is missing — 我很高兴认识你, 给我试一下, 发照片给我吧, a fronted time word in up-l3-e4, 我的名字是阮海 (accepted in speech), 扫码可以吗 (accepted in the shop scenario), 我来晚了 (taught in u0-l1-e7).

Second class: rubric slots and speech menus narrower than natural Chinese (喜欢听音乐 for 'thích âm nhạc', 见面 tokenized as one word so the 见 slot fails, 十八块一碗 — the 'price per unit' order the course teaches in ui-l1 — missing from all three price speech items).

HSK tracks: items read as original and HSK 3.0 level 1-2; pools are one-answer except hsk_1.a_r3_02. The 书写 component pools hold: for every target the other pool components either make no character or one with another reading (仅/叹/奴 with 又, 付/讨 with 寸, 佼/咬/姣 with 交). Pass and readiness wording is honest (reference threshold, 'không phải điểm HSK').
Story questions: 126 read; keys match the texts; inference items mostly sound. Two wording issues only.

findings.problem: Match pairs 个=cái and 件=cái share the native text 'cái'. match.tsx resolves a native tile by text (first pair wins), so 件 can never be matched: the exercise cannot be completed and every correct attempt on 件 is marked wrong.
findings.fix: Give 件 its own gloss, e.g. 件='cái (áo, việc)' and 个='cái (chung)', or swap 件 for 张=tờ; add a self-check rule: native texts in one match must be distinct.

findings.problem: 'Rất vui được quen bạn.' Tiles 很 快乐 你 我 认识 高兴. 我很高兴认识你 (the standard textbook form) is built from the same tiles and rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternative: 我 很 高兴 认识 你

findings.problem: 'Cho tôi thử một chút.' Tiles 一下 试 给 我 扫. 给我试一下 is the most literal and fully natural rendering of 'cho tôi thử' and is rejected (only 我试一下 accepted).
findings.fix: Add alternative: 给 我 试 一下

findings.problem: 'Gửi ảnh cho tôi nhé.' Tiles 的 我 吧 给 照片 打 发. 发照片给我吧 (V + O + 给 + person) is correct, common, and buildable from the tiles; rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternative: 发 照片 给 我 吧

findings.problem: 'Hôm qua tôi đi siêu thị, sau đó về nhà.' Only 我 昨天 去了 超市 然后 回家 is accepted; 昨天 我 去了 超市 然后 回家 (time word first, the course's own stated rule, listed on every other time-word word bank) is rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternative: 昨天 我 去了 超市 然后 回家

findings.problem: 'Tôi không có em gái.' Key 我没有妹妹 with no alternatives. 我没妹妹 (没 alone for 没有, the unit's own topic) is correct and very common; rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternative: 我没妹妹

findings.problem: 'Hôm qua tôi không đi.' Only 我昨天没去 / 昨天我没去. 我昨天没有去 and 昨天我没有去 are equally correct; rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: 我昨天没有去 | 昨天我没有去

findings.problem: 'Tôi ăn cơm rồi.' 我吃过了 / 我吃过饭了 — the everyday reply to 你吃饭了吗 — is rejected (过 is taught two lessons later and in u3-l3). Same on up-l3-e3 ('Tôi đã ăn cơm rồi.').
findings.fix: Add alternatives: 我吃过饭了 | 我吃过了 | 我已经吃过饭了 | 我已经吃过了

findings.problem: 'Tôi đến muộn mười phút.' 我来晚了十分钟 (来晚 is taught in u0-l1-e7 and accepted in zh.speak.k_sorry) is rejected; also 我晚了十分钟.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: 我来晚了十分钟 | 我来晚了10分钟 | 我晚了十分钟 | 我晚了10分钟

findings.problem: 'Rẻ một chút đi.' Accepts 便宜一点儿吧 | 便宜点儿吧 | 便宜一点吧 but not 便宜点吧 — the most frequent spoken form, and the 一点儿/一点 pair rule applied to 点儿. 便宜一点儿 without 吧 is also natural.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: 便宜点吧 | 便宜一点儿 | 便宜一点 | 便宜点儿 | 便宜点

findings.problem: 'Tôi tên là Nguyễn Hải.' Accepts 我叫阮海 | 我是阮海; 我的名字是阮海 and 我的名字叫阮海 are correct and are accepted by the speech items for the same prompt (zh.speak.l_name); rejected here.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: 我的名字是阮海 | 我的名字叫阮海

findings.problem: 'Quét mã được không?' Accepts 可以扫码吗 | 能扫码吗 | 我可以扫码吗. 扫码可以吗 is the commonest word order at a till and is accepted for the same intent by zh.scenario.shop_fruit; 能不能扫码 / 可不可以扫码 are also correct.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: 扫码可以吗 | 能不能扫码 | 可不可以扫码 | 可以扫码不

findings.problem: 'Tôi gọi điện cho mẹ.' Only 我给妈妈打电话. 我打电话给妈妈 (equally standard) and 我给我妈妈打电话 are rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: 我打电话给妈妈 | 我给我妈妈打电话 | 我打电话给我妈妈

findings.problem: zh.write.cp5_like_music slot 'like' = 喜欢音乐 only. 我喜欢听音乐 (arguably the most natural Chinese for 'thích âm nhạc') tokenizes 喜欢 听 音乐, so the contiguous run is missing and the checkpoint item fails; 我爱音乐 fails too.
findings.fix: Slot variants: 喜欢音乐 | 喜欢听音乐 | 爱音乐 | 爱听音乐

findings.problem: zh.write.a1cap_note_station slot 'meet' = 见. 见面 is a course lexeme, so the lexicon-bound tokenizer makes 我们五点在火车站见面吧 one token 见面 and the 见 slot is not realized: a correct capstone answer fails. 五点在火车站等你 also fails.
findings.fix: Slot variants: 见 | 见面 | 等你 | 等我

findings.problem: zh.write.p_link: slot 'work' = 上班 | 去工厂 | 去公司; 然后去工作 ('sau đó đi làm', very natural) fails. Slot 'link' = 然后 only, though the instruction says 'Dùng một từ nối' (以后 / 再 also link: 我吃了早饭以后去上班).
findings.fix: work: + 去工作 | 工作; link: + 以后 | 再 | 之后

findings.problem: Price replies accept 一碗十八块 but not 十八块一碗 — the 'price + per unit' order the course teaches (苹果五块钱一斤, ui-l1-e3; 多少钱一斤). Same gap in the two reserved price items. Speech items have no requiredConcepts, so only listed variants pass.
findings.fix: m_price + 十八块一碗 | 十八块钱一碗; cp4_price_tea + 五块一瓶 | 五块钱一瓶; a1cap_price_coffee + 二十块一杯 | 二十块钱一杯

findings.problem: 他（　）我的哥哥。 with pool 本 是 喜欢 热 回 名字: 他喜欢我的哥哥 ('he likes my older brother') is also grammatical and meaningful, so the distractor 喜欢 is also correct when the item is scored on its own.
findings.fix: Change the stem so only 是 fits, e.g. 我（　）越南人。 (我喜欢越南人 is still possible, so avoid a person/nationality noun) — safest: 这（　）我的书。 (这喜欢我的书 is ungrammatical); keep 喜欢 for a_r3_01 only.

findings.problem: 'hai người' tiles 二 人 个 本 两. 两人 (no 个) is correct Chinese (common in writing and set phrases: 我们两人) and is rejected; the item tests 两 vs 二, which 两人 also shows.
findings.fix: Add alternative: 两 人

findings.problem: 'Tàu tám giờ khởi hành.' Only 火车 八点 出发. 八点 火车 出发 (time word first, the course's rule) is grammatical, if it can also read as 'the 8 o'clock train leaves'.
findings.fix: Add alternative: 八点 火车 出发

findings.problem: 'Tôi sống ở Hà Nội.' Only 我 住 在 河内; 我 在 河内 住 (在 + place before the verb) is also correct. Same on uo-l3-e4 (我 朋友 在 上海 住).
findings.fix: Add alternatives: 我 在 河内 住 / 我 朋友 在 上海 住

findings.problem: 'Tôi ở ký túc xá.' Vietnamese 'ở' also means 'live in' (the course itself renders 'Tôi sống ở ký túc xá' as 我住在宿舍 in uj-l0-e6). 我住在宿舍 / 我住宿舍 are defensible and rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: 我住在宿舍 | 我住宿舍 — or make the prompt unambiguous ('Bây giờ tôi đang ở ký túc xá.')

findings.problem: 'Chìa khoá ở trên bàn.' Only 钥匙在桌子上. 钥匙在桌子上面 and 钥匙在桌上 are correct and common; rejected (上面 is not a lexeme, which matters only for display).
findings.fix: Add alternatives: 钥匙在桌子上面 | 钥匙在桌上

findings.problem: 'Cái áo này màu trắng.' Only 这件衣服是白的. 这件衣服是白色的 is the most natural rendering of 'màu trắng' and what a pinyin IME offers for baise; rejected. Same for the spoken zh.speak.cp4_desc_shirt.
findings.fix: Add 这件衣服是白色的 | 这件衣服白色的 (typed); speech + 这件衣服是白色的 | 白色的衣服. If the self-check forbids non-lexeme hanzi in alternatives, add 白色 as a lexeme.

findings.problem: 'Tôi đến từ Việt Nam.' 我来自越南 (来自 = lai tự, the likeliest guess of a Vietnamese learner) is correct and rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternative: 我来自越南

findings.problem: 'Tôi là công nhân.' Only 我是工人; 我是一个工人 / 我是一名工人 are correct and very commonly produced; rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: 我是一个工人 | 我是一名工人

findings.problem: 'Tôi thích nghe nhạc.' Only 我喜欢听音乐 (no alternatives); 我喜欢听歌 is the everyday phrase for 'nghe nhạc', 我爱听音乐 also correct. ul-l3-e5 'Tôi thích âm nhạc.' accepts only 我喜欢音乐 although 我喜欢听音乐 is a natural rendering.
findings.fix: um-l3-e5 + 我喜欢听歌 | 我爱听音乐 | 我爱听歌; ul-l3-e5 + 我喜欢听音乐 | 我爱音乐

findings.problem: 'Năm nay bạn bao nhiêu tuổi?' Accepts 你今年几岁 but not 你今年几岁了, and not 你今年多少岁 / 你今年多少岁了 (a direct rendering of 'bao nhiêu tuổi').
findings.fix: Add alternatives: 你今年几岁了 | 你今年多少岁 | 你今年多少岁了 | 今年你多少岁

findings.problem: 'Hôm nay nóng.' 今天天气很热 (the unit's own sentence pattern 今天天气很好) is correct and rejected; also 今天很热啊.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: 今天天气很热 | 今天天气热

findings.uncertain: 美 is not a course lexeme; adding it to a typed alternative may trip the reading self-check.
findings.problem: 'Mùa thu rất đẹp.' Key 秋天很漂亮 is acceptable but a native says 秋天很美 first; 秋天非常好看 is missing while 秋天非常漂亮 is listed.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: 秋天很美 | 秋天非常好看 | 秋天真漂亮

findings.problem: 'Sinh nhật tôi là ngày năm tháng năm.' The written-standard 日 (五月五日) is rejected, and so are 我生日五月五号 / 我生日5月5号 (no 的, no 是) while their 的-forms are listed. Same 日 gap on the form zh.write.cp5_form_clinic (四月五号 only) and the birthday speech items.
findings.fix: Typed: + 我的生日是五月五日 | 我生日是五月五日 | 我生日五月五号 | 我生日5月5号 (and digit mixes); form slot + 四月五日; speech + …日 forms

findings.uncertain: Usage of 可以 for learned ability is disputed among teachers; many natives accept it in speech.
findings.problem: 我___说一点儿汉语 ('Tôi biết nói một chút tiếng Trung') with options 会 想 要 可以: 我可以说一点儿汉语 is heard from natives and is not clearly wrong.
findings.fix: Replace the distractor 可以 with 是 or 在.

findings.problem: 几 → key 'mấy' with distractor 'bao nhiêu'. Vietnamese routinely renders 几 as 'bao nhiêu' (几个 = bao nhiêu cái, 几岁 = bao nhiêu tuổi), so the distractor is also a defensible gloss.
findings.fix: Replace 'bao nhiêu' with 'ai' or 'gì'.

findings.problem: 'Tôi sẽ đến muộn ba mươi phút.' Missing natural forms: 我会晚到半个小时 / 我要晚半个小时到 (半个小时 = 30 phút), 我要迟到三十分钟, 我会晚三十分钟到.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: 我会晚到半个小时 | 我要晚到半个小时 | 我要迟到三十分钟 | 我会晚三十分钟到 | 我要迟到30分钟

findings.problem: 'Tôi muốn làm một thẻ ngân hàng.' 我要办一张银行卡 / 我想办银行卡 are rejected although zh.scenario.bank_account accepts 我要办银行卡 for the same intent.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: 我要办一张银行卡 | 我想办银行卡 | 我要办银行卡 | 我要办1张银行卡

findings.problem: 'Tôi đau đầu.' / 'Tôi đau bụng.' accept 我头疼 | 我头很疼 and 我肚子疼 | 我肚子很疼 only. 我的头很疼, 我的肚子疼 and the widespread 我头痛 / 我肚子痛 are rejected.
findings.fix: Add 我的头很疼 | 我的头疼 | 我头痛 | 我头很痛; 我的肚子疼 | 我的肚子很疼 | 我肚子痛 | 我肚子很痛

findings.problem: 'Xin dừng ở đây.' (taxi) — 请在这儿停车 / 在这儿停车吧 (停车 is a lexeme) are the commonest taxi phrasing and rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: 请在这儿停车 | 在这儿停车 | 请在这里停车 | 在这里停车 | 就在这儿停吧

findings.problem: 'Cảm ơn!' key 谢谢！ with no alternatives; 谢谢你 / 谢谢您 are natural and accepted by the course's speech items for thanks; a checkpoint should not reject them.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: 谢谢你 | 谢谢您

findings.problem: zh.write.o_family slot 'like' = 喜欢做饭; 我喜欢做菜 ('nấu ăn' is as much 做菜 as 做饭) and 我爱做饭 fail.
findings.fix: like: 喜欢做饭 | 喜欢做菜 | 爱做饭 | 爱做菜

findings.problem: zh.write.p_who slot 'morning' = 早上 | 每天早上. 'buổi sáng' is equally 上午; 阮南上午喝咖啡 fails.
findings.fix: morning: + 上午 | 每天上午

findings.problem: zh.write.cp5_note_movie slot 'invite' = 吧 | 好吗. 小王，晚上七点一起去看电影，怎么样？ (the most common invitation tag) and …好不好？ fail.
findings.fix: invite: + 怎么样 | 好不好 | 行吗 | 可以吗

findings.problem: zh.write.cp5_note_late slot 'late' = 晚到 | 迟到. 我会晚十五分钟到 (晚 … 到 split), 我会来晚十五分钟 fail although natural.
findings.fix: late: + 来晚 | 晚 (or restructure: accept 晚 together with the minutes slot)

findings.problem: zh.write.cp5_mail_shift slot 'rest' needs the exact runs 可以请假吗 / 能请假吗 / 可以休息吗 / 能休息吗. 星期六我想请假，可以吗？, 星期六我能不能请假？ and 星期六可不可以休息？ fail.
findings.fix: rest: + 请假可以吗 | 请假，可以吗 | 能不能请假 | 可不可以请假 | 能不能休息 | 可不可以休息 | 想请假

findings.problem: zh.write.q_late slot 'bus' = 公交车来晚了 | 公交车晚了. 公交车晚点了 (the standard word for a late vehicle) and 公交车迟到了 fail.
findings.fix: bus: + 公交车晚点了 | 公交车迟到了 | 公交车来得很晚

findings.problem: 'Có người hỏi giờ. Hãy trả lời.' accepts 现在八点 | 八点 | 八点了 | 现在是八点 but not 现在八点了 — the most natural full reply. Same in the two reserved time items.
findings.fix: + 现在八点了 / 现在十点了 / 现在九点了

findings.problem: Picture 'con chó to': 条 is a standard classifier for dogs (一条狗); 这条狗很大 / 这是一条大狗 are rejected. 这只狗非常大 is also missing (n_cat lists 非常).
findings.fix: + 这条狗很大 | 这是一条大狗 | 这只狗非常大

findings.problem: Picture 'chiếc xe mới': 这辆车是新的 (the 是…的 pattern the same unit teaches with 白的) is rejected.
findings.fix: + 这辆车是新的 | 车是新的

findings.problem: 'Buổi trưa, bạn gặp một người quen trên phố. Hãy chào.' 中午好 is a natural noon greeting (parallel to 早上好/晚上好 taught in u0) and is rejected.
findings.fix: + 中午好 | 中午好啊

findings.problem: requiredConcepts accept wrong answers: l0 [[第一, 是, 对]] — 不是 and 不对 tokenize as 不 + 是/对, so '不是，我以前来过' passes as 'first visit'. Same leniency: a1cap_shift_change l0 [[可以, 能, 没问题, 好的]] passes 不能 / 不可以 as acceptance; taxi l1 passes 不好; cp6_clinic_cough l1 [[不, 没, 没有]] passes any sentence with 不 (我很不舒服) as 'no fever'.
findings.fix: Use multi-token concepts: clinic_reception [[第一次, 是第一, 对，第一]] ; shift_change [[可以, 能, 没问题]] plus a grader rule or authored check that a concept run is not preceded by 不/没; cough l1 [[不发烧, 没发烧, 没有发烧, 没有]].

findings.uncertain: Policy question, not a content slip: zh.ts deliberately keeps dictation strict; zh-plan §9 says traditional is accepted wherever the learner types.
findings.problem: Dictation uses normalizeStrict (no traditional fold), so a learner with a traditional IME who types 請先下車，後上車 is marked wrong, against the plan's script policy. Affects every zh dictation.
findings.fix: Owner decision: either fold traditional in the zh dictation comparison (word level, as the lenient form does) or state in zh-plan §9 that dictation requires simplified.

findings.problem: Question #3 (infer) 'Trong gia đình Hoa, ai đang ở Trung Quốc?' key 'Chỉ có Hoa': the text says where the parents and the sister are, but not the younger brother or the grandparents in the photo, so the key is not supported.
findings.fix: Ask 'Ai trong gia đình Hoa đang ở nhà (ở Việt Nam)?' with key 'Bố mẹ và em gái', or add a sentence placing the brother and grandparents at home.

findings.problem: 'Đừng hút thuốc!' lists six forms with 吸烟 but none with 抽烟, the everyday spoken verb (别抽烟, 不要抽烟). 抽烟 is not a lexeme, so a learner is less likely to type it.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: 别抽烟 | 不要抽烟 | 请不要抽烟

findings.problem: 'hai đôi giày' accepts 两双鞋 | 2双鞋; 两双鞋子 (鞋子 is very common colloquially; IME offers it for xiezi) is rejected.
findings.fix: Add alternatives: 两双鞋子 | 2双鞋子

findings.problem: Question #1 'Hoa mượn ông Vương những gì?' key 'Hai đôi đũa và một cái cốc': Hoa asked to borrow one pair (option 'Một đôi đũa'), the old man gave more. 'mượn' makes the distractor arguable.
findings.fix: Reword: 'Ông Vương đưa cho Hoa những gì?'

findings.uncertain: Not run: depends on how normalizeSpoken/spellDigitRuns treat a hyphenated vs an unbroken 11-digit run.
findings.problem: Phone slots list only the hyphenated form (138-1234-5678). A learner typing 13812345678 or 138 1234 5678 may tokenize differently (digit runs are spelled as numbers) and fail the slot. Same on the dorm form and the three cp5 forms.
findings.fix: Run the writing evaluator on the three spellings; if they differ, add the unbroken and space-separated variants.

findings.problem: Clip 明天是我的生日，我十八岁了。 — with 明天 the natural sentence is 我就十八岁了; as written it says the speaker is already 18. The key (十八岁) is unaffected.
findings.fix: 明天是我的生日，我就十八岁了。 or 今天是我的生日，我十八岁了。
